read_method: GitHub connector fetch_file pinned to source_commit; direct textual examination of native SVG element attributes, independent of image-record declarations
method: Count actual data-kind attributes in SVG; extract each data-occupied-storey, data-floor-z-m, data-body-width-m and compare with V6 floor_datums_m_assumed/body_widths_m_assumed arrays using absolute height tolerance 1e-8 m.
scope_limit: Native source count and parameter consistency only. Does not independently validate raster visibility, historical geometry, full-city scale, structural feasibility, deployment, browser behaviour or artifact archive completeness.
